sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase year pages: six new findings on the Event column, the checks BruceBaseParser made on a year page. Two need no request and show with the table: ⚠️ "Brucebase anchor with another date than its entry" (the anchor is not the date as day, month, year: "000472b" on an entry of 1972-05-00) and ⚠️ "Brucebase anchor letter differs from the event page's address" (several entries on one date: the letter on the anchor against the letter after the date in the address; common in the early 1970s). The others show once ▶ Pages has read an entry's page, with no request of their own: ❌ "Brucebase event page named differently from the year page", ⚠️ "Brucebase event page adds (Early), (Late), … to the name" (also Afternoon, Evening, First, Second, Third, Morning, Soundcheck), ❌ "Brucebase event page links another entry of the year page" (its "Info & Setlist" link), and ⚠️ "Brucebase title with two blanks or a blank before a comma" (the heading at once, the page's title once read; year listings too). Names are compared as the wiki writes them, in capitals, with "Stone Pony (The)" read as "The Stone Pony" — never the text in MusicBrainz title style. Each has a row in the ⚠️ / ❌ menus and the 📊 dropdown, tints its Event cell, says what differs in the cell's tooltip (above "As written on the site"), and is kept by Save to Disk. Nine new settings under ⚙️ → ⚠️ Findings: a switch per finding and three tints (name, anchor, blanks), all on.

Link previews of other sites are read again once after this update (their stored records get two new fields for the checks above): the first hover or ▶ Pages on a page read before asks the site again.
